title: Good quality, well packaged. It's not that great for cooking pasta.
text: Good quality, well packaged. It's not that great for cooking pasta.. The product is just as described but after cooking pasta I noticed it came out worse than I expected it, I always cook it the same way so I was surprised to see that this time it broke down and was very mushy for whatever reason, this had never happened to me before, it was weird. I thought I should point it out because using my normal smaller pan that I had this had never happened until I used this, maybe better for stew or vegetables? The pasta did not work for me.

product_metadata.title: Cook N Home 4-Piece 8 Quart Multipots, Stainless Steel Pasta Cooker Steamer
features: PASTA POT SETS - Cook N Home Pasta Pot with Strainer Lid 8-Quart, 4-Piece includes 8-Quart Stockpot, Steamer Insert, Pasta Insert/Pot, and a Tempered Glass Lid for your cooking needs.

HIGH-QUALITY CONSTRUCTION: The Pasta Pot Cooker Steamer is made of mirror-polished 18/10 stainless steel, not easy to deform. There is an aluminum disc bottom between the steel layers to heat food evenly for better cooking results.

MULTI-FUNCTION - The Multipots Steamer has a variety of cooking functions, not only can be used to cook pasta but also can accommodate other foods, which is ideal for steaming vegetables, seafood, etc. It is a convenient and practical cooking tool.
GLASS LID & COMFORTABLE HANDLES - Tempered glass lids with steam vent to view food while cooking. Riveted stainless steel handles are durable, comfortable, and wide/deep for a secure grip.

MULTI-STOVE COMPATIBLE - Induction compatible, our Pasta pot can be used with a variety of heat sources, including gas, electric glass, ceramic, and halogen. It is a versatile addition to your kitchen. Dishwasher safe.
description: The Cook N Home 4-piece 8 quart pasta cooker steamer multipots, stainless steel includes an 8 quart stockpot, steamer insert, pasta insert-pot, and a tempered glass lid. Made of polished stainless steel with an encapsulated aluminum bottom for even heat distribution. Induction compatible. The Cook N Home 4-Piece 8 Quart Pasta Cooker Steamer Multipots, Stainless Steel includes an 8 quart stockpot, steamer insert, pasta insert/pot, and a tempered glass lid.
